newsitem.title: USA: AAR Q2 results led by trading business.
newsitem.headline: AAR Q2 results led by trading business.

text.p: AAR Corp said Thursday that its results for the fiscal second quarter were led by a strong performance by its trading business.
Earlier, AAR reported earnings for the second quarter ended November 30 of $0.32 a share, up from $0.23 a year ago. AAR supplies aerospace and aviation products and services.

"The second quarter results were in line with our expectations and were led by a very strong performance from our trading business," David Storch, president, said in a statement. "Long-term inventory management programs contributed significantly to our results for the period and have become a more meaningful part of our business. In addition, our operating units have put in place marketing initiatives aimed at developing new long-term inventory and maintenance programs throughout our worldwide customer base."
